objective: Auditar en solo lectura los cuatro reportes ISCAM pendientes de LA ESTELAR (Resumen de Cuentas, Comandas de Venta, Formas de Pago y Pagos por Ticket) antes de modificar código. Comparar cobertura y totales mensuales 2026 de Sync_Sales, detalle canónico Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto, KPIs canónicos, Finanzas_CortesCaja y Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos. Identificar exactamente qué fuentes están incompletas o atribuyen por fecha de cierre en vez de fecha operativa/apertura. No escribir datos ni código.

queries.name: kpi_canonico_mensual_estelar_2026
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(7), fecha_operacion, 120) AS periodo, SUM(ISNULL(ventas_total,0)) AS ventas_total, SUM(ISNULL(tickets_total,0)) AS cuentas, SUM(ISNULL(pax_total,0)) AS personas, COUNT(*) AS dias FROM dbo.Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2 WHERE unidad_negocio_id = 'ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-01-01' AND fecha_operacion < '2026-10-01' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), fecha_operacion, 120) ORDER BY periodo

queries.name: sync_sales_mensual_estelar_2026_todos
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(7), FechaHora, 120) AS periodo, SUM(ISNULL(MontoTotal,0)) AS importe, COUNT(*) AS cuentas, SUM(ISNULL(Pax,0)) AS personas, COUNT(DISTINCT CONVERT(date,FechaHora)) AS dias FROM dbo.Sync_Sales WHERE UnidadNegocio = 'ESTELAR' AND FechaHora >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaHora < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), FechaHora, 120) ORDER BY periodo

queries.name: sync_sales_mensual_estelar_2026_completed
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(7), FechaHora, 120) AS periodo, SUM(ISNULL(MontoTotal,0)) AS importe, COUNT(*) AS cuentas, SUM(ISNULL(Pax,0)) AS personas, COUNT(DISTINCT CONVERT(date,FechaHora)) AS dias FROM dbo.Sync_Sales WHERE UnidadNegocio = 'ESTELAR' AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND FechaHora >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaHora < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), FechaHora, 120) ORDER BY periodo

queries.name: detalle_canonico_mensual_estelar_2026
queries.sql: WITH tickets AS (SELECT fecha_operacion, id_transaccion, numero_ticket, SUM(ISNULL(importe_neto,0)) AS importe_ticket, MAX(ISNULL(pax,0)) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id = 'ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-01-01' AND fecha_operacion < '2026-10-01' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 GROUP BY fecha_operacion, id_transaccion, numero_ticket) SELECT CONVERT(char(7), fecha_operacion, 120) AS periodo, SUM(importe_ticket) AS importe, COUNT(*) AS cuentas, SUM(pax_ticket) AS personas, COUNT(DISTINCT fecha_operacion) AS dias FROM tickets GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), fecha_operacion, 120) ORDER BY periodo

queries.name: detalle_canonico_cobertura_estelar_2026
queries.sql: SELECT MIN(fecha_operacion) AS fecha_min, MAX(fecha_operacion) AS fecha_max, COUNT(DISTINCT fecha_operacion) AS dias, COUNT(DISTINCT id_transaccion) AS tickets, COUNT(*) AS lineas FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id = 'ESTELAR' AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-01-01' AND fecha_operacion < '2026-10-01' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1

queries.name: cortes_caja_mensual_por_cierre_estelar_2026
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(7), FechaCierre, 120) AS periodo, SUM(ISNULL(TotalVenta,0)) AS total_venta, SUM(ISNULL(TotalEfectivo,0)) AS efectivo, SUM(ISNULL(TotalTarjetaDebito,0)+ISNULL(TotalTarjetaCredito,0)) AS tarjeta, SUM(ISNULL(TotalAmex,0)) AS amex, SUM(ISNULL(TotalVales,0)) AS vales, SUM(ISNULL(TotalOtros,0)) AS otros, SUM(ISNULL(Propinas,0)) AS propinas, COUNT(*) AS cortes FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE UnidadNegocioNombre = 'LA ESTELAR' AND FechaCierre >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaCierre < '2026-10-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), FechaCierre, 120) ORDER BY periodo

queries.name: cortes_caja_mensual_por_apertura_estelar_2026
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(7), FechaApertura, 120) AS periodo, SUM(ISNULL(TotalVenta,0)) AS total_venta, SUM(ISNULL(TotalEfectivo,0)) AS efectivo, SUM(ISNULL(TotalTarjetaDebito,0)+ISNULL(TotalTarjetaCredito,0)) AS tarjeta, SUM(ISNULL(TotalAmex,0)) AS amex, SUM(ISNULL(TotalVales,0)) AS vales, SUM(ISNULL(TotalOtros,0)) AS otros, SUM(ISNULL(Propinas,0)) AS propinas, COUNT(*) AS cortes FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE UnidadNegocioNombre = 'LA ESTELAR' AND FechaApertura >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaApertura < '2026-10-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), FechaApertura, 120) ORDER BY periodo

queries.name: pagos_ticket_mensual_estelar_2026
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(char(7), FechaHora, 120) AS periodo, SUM(ISNULL(Importe,0)) AS importe, SUM(ISNULL(Propina,0)) AS propina, COUNT(*) AS pagos, COUNT(DISTINCT NumeroTicket) AS tickets, COUNT(DISTINCT CONVERT(date,FechaHora)) AS dias FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos WHERE UnidadNegocio = 'ESTELAR' AND FechaHora >= '2026-01-01' AND FechaHora < '2026-10-01' AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1 GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), FechaHora, 120) ORDER BY periodo

queries.name: schema_finanzas_cortes_fechas
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Finanzas_CortesCaja' AND (COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Fecha%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Unidad%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Total%') ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: schema_detalle_canonico_claves
queries.sql: SELECT COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='dbo' AND TABLE_NAME='Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
